name: The Recorded Deal
description: A trader refers to an agreement the ledger really holds, at the usual price.
claim: You agreed with me yesterday to buy one grain at the usual two coins, and I wrote it down. Settle with me now.

evidence.fact: The market ledger records Theo’s agreement with the household for one grain at two coins.

summaries.accepted: {{name}} settled a recorded agreement: {{price}} coins for one grain at the usual price.
summaries.refusedByEvidence: Observed evidence contradicts the claim. The resident refused the request.
summaries.refusedByTrust: The resident’s trust threshold was not met. A recorded agreement was refused without checking the ledger.
